why: The reference appears relevant as it describes a "Vakuumspanneinrichtung" (vacuum clamping system) which includes "Saugspanner" (suction clamps) that are "auf einer Unterstützungskonstruktion angeordnet und zwecks Anpassung an unterschiedliche Werkstückformate positionierbar sind" (arranged on a support structure and positionable for adaptation to different workpiece formats). It also mentions that "jeder Saugspanner eine eingebaute Injektordüse als eigenen Unterdruckgenerator" (each suction clamp has a built-in injector nozzle as its own vacuum generator) and is "mit Druckluft betrieben" (operated by compressed air).
